breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified that a Knudsen number of 5 makes the continuum Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip walls an invalid modeling approach. It replaced this incorrect instruction with the appropriate method for this flow regime (DSMC) and specified a suitable boundary condition (Maxwell diffuse-reflection), directly aligning with the correction in the ground truth.
